description.value: Cap's Bicycle Shop is a Specialized-authorized retailer and repair shop serving New Westminster, operating as Specialized Bicycle Components Canada Inc. D.B.A Cap's Bicycle Shop. The shop sells bicycles, accessories, and clothing alongside an in-store repair service, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists needing mechanical support in the New Westminster area. It runs on Shopify with an online storefront backed by a 30-day return policy and a dedicated 7-day bike exchange policy.

address.value: 434A East Columbia Street, New Westminster, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Cap's is an active Specialized-authorized bicycle and repair store at 434A E Columbia St, New Westminster — not North Vancouver as OSM's community field states; East Columbia Street is in New Westminster and the website repeats this city name on every page. The site describes itself as a 'Bicycle, accessories, clothing, and repair store' confirming repair capabilities; no website content addresses pump availability, touring parts, e-bike service, or any other specific amenities beyond retail and repair.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the business is in New Westminster — website repeats 'New Westminster' on every page and East Columbia Street is a New Westminster address. OSM community tag should be corrected.
OSM record has no phone number; website provides 604-524-3611 (contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there was no OSM value to cross-check).

Two different contact emails appear on the website: info-capsnw@specialized.com (store contact) and info@capsbicycleshop.com (online returns). These may reflect the Specialized corporate ownership structure.
OSM addr:unit is 'A' but the main OSM address field omits the unit; website consistently uses '434A' — minor formatting inconsistency, not a substantive error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, staffed bicycle repair and retail shop; a clear fit for touring cyclists needing mechanical support or parts in the New Westminster area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business is operated by Specialized Bicycle Components Canada Inc. D.B.A Cap's Bicycle Shop, indicating corporate Specialized ownership rather than an independent operator.
